llm_response.reason: The website claims official ties to the well-known Aubade brand but is not listed as an authorized distributor or boutique on the official Aubade site. There is no legally required business imprint (Impressum) or transparent company information, indicating an attempt to disguise ownership—common in scam sites targeting German shoppers. The site also emphasizes limited-time offers and major discounts, which are well-known scam tactics. Additionally, there is an overall lack of third-party validation or trust signals, and no trace of real business presence.
